description: This file is a C header file declaring interfaces for an autosensing module. It includes function prototypes for controlling and querying autonomous sensing features, as well as some macro definitions and external library includes.

methods.name: is_autosensing_enabled
methods.description: Function to check if autosensing is enabled.

methods.name: autosensing_found_mode
methods.description: Indicates that an autosensing mode has been detected.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_start
methods.description: Starts the autosensing process, optionally in sense current mode.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_notify_intf_changed
methods.description: Notifies that an interface has changed state (up or down) with optional restart.
